title: Finite ranks on an affine part of the universal rank-matching point locus
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be flat, proper and locally of finite presentation, and let $E$ be a finite locally free module on $X$. Write $R(f,E,g)$ for the universal rank clause [def-sc-picard-universal-rank-match]. For every affine open $U\subseteq S$ there is a finite set $A\subseteq\mathbb N$ such that for every $s\in U$ with $R(f,E,\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)\to S)$, there is $r\in A$ for which the tensor pullback of $E$ to $X_s=X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ is finite locally free of rank $r$. Empty fibres are included by adjoining rank zero.

source.place: Tag 0BDP, first three proof paragraphs: rank decomposition and perfect direct images

proof.text: Properness makes the inverse image of the affine open compact. Choose finite free trivializations using Modules.exists_mem_over_iso_free, take a finite subcover, and let R be the image of its ranks with zero inserted.

At s in U satisfying R(f,E,Spec kappa(s) to S), test the identity of Spec kappa(s) and its unique point. The nonempty open neighbourhood is the entire one-point scheme, so the third clause gives a constant rank r on the fibre.

For a nonempty fibre choose a point z and a trivializing cover member V containing its image. Compare the tensor pullback with the categorical pullback by uniqueness of left adjoints. Restrict to the inverse image of V; pullback composition gives an isomorphism to the pullback of the trivialization. This restricted module has both the fibre rank r and the cover rank n. Applying finiteLocallyFreeOfRank_stalk_finrank at z twice gives r=n. If the fibre is empty, the empty family is a covering and establishes finite local freeness of rank zero directly.

proof_origin.place: Rank decomposition argument, implemented by finite compact subcover, pullback isomorphisms and stalk finrank comparison; empty fibres handled by the empty covering.

lean.statement:
theorem picardUniversalRankMatch_finiteRanks {X S : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (E : X.Modules) [E.IsFiniteLocallyFree] (U : S.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) :
    ∃ R : Finset ℕ, ∀ s : S, s ∈ U →
      PicardUniversalRankMatch f E (S.fromSpecResidueField s) →
      ∃ r ∈ R,
        SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u}
          ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (S.fromSpecResidueField s))).obj E) r
